qualification: Actual changed checkpoint must pass its own behavior-specific start/stop validation; parent evidence cannot be inherited
physical_input: Environmental sensory transduction only; no desired state, motor waveform, muscle zeroing or whole-brain freeze as positive control
required_checks: causal interneuron output block with baseline movement retained
scope: Candidate functional roles, not unique decision-cell types; RIS full GABA/peptide biology remains unimplemented
on_state_criteria: Behavior-specific physiological timescale and motor/physical targets;1.8Hz is the current swimming example, not a universal neural rate
rest_criteria: Actual low motion and sustained state after transient cue; no masking by detrending or externally disabled dynamics
